mentions.name: Lapse
mentions.description: This app is a personal memory layer that AI agents can read from and write to. Users can talk to it, dump half-formed thoughts, or send content without organizing it, and the agent figures out where it belongs. It offers MCP support for Claude, a simple HTTP API for other integrations, an iPhone Shortcut for quick voice capture, and a Chrome extension that logs selected text as a lapse. It is a closed system usable for journaling, meeting notes, reminders, and second-brain workflows.
mentions.problem: The author kept losing fleeting thoughts — ideas that showed up while walking or before falling asleep — before finding the right app to write them down, so built Lapse as a place for those thoughts to live.
